# OpenInfinity Design

> Brand and design resources for OpenInfinity: logo, app icons, colour, typography, motion, templates and brand guidelines. Every file can be downloaded directly.

OpenInfinity 的品牌与设计资源：标志、应用图标、色彩、字体、动效、模板和品牌规范，所有文件均可直接下载。

Pages: [English](https://design.open-infinity.com/) · [中文](https://design.open-infinity.com/zh/)

## Logo

The mark is two "leaves" — each a circle with one square corner — in the golden ratio 1 : 0.618, meeting corner to corner on a 45° diagonal to form an infinity sign. Black on white is primary; white on black is the reverse. The wordmark is Geist Medium at −2.5% tracking, outlined. Clear space is 1X on every side (X = small-leaf radius = 0.191 × mark width); minimum size 16 px / 6 mm.

- [Mark, black (SVG)](https://design.open-infinity.com/assets/logo/mark/openinfinity-mark-black.svg)
- [Horizontal lockup, black (SVG)](https://design.open-infinity.com/assets/logo/lockup-horizontal/openinfinity-lockup-horizontal-black.svg)
- [Vertical lockup, black (SVG)](https://design.open-infinity.com/assets/logo/lockup-vertical/openinfinity-lockup-vertical-black.svg)
- [Wordmark, black (SVG)](https://design.open-infinity.com/assets/logo/wordmark/openinfinity-wordmark-black.svg)

## Colour

- Ink / 墨: #000000 — Primary: logo, text
- Paper / 白: #FFFFFF — Primary: background
- Graphite / 石墨: #18181B — UI dark text
- Mist / 雾白: #F5F5F4 — UI light surface
- Midnight / 午夜: #0B1220 — Dark mode, slides
- Signal / 信号橙: #FF4D00 — Accent (optional)
- Electric / 电光蓝: #2440FF — Accent (optional)
- Lime / 青柠: #C8F560 — Accent (optional)

## Typography

- Geist (Latin, numerals, wordmark) and Geist Mono (code) — SIL Open Font License 1.1
- Source Han Sans / Noto Sans SC (Chinese) — SIL Open Font License 1.1
